verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents a dedicated guide for downloading call and voicemail recordings via its API (dialpad-docs-3), a first-party path for exporting part of a user's data. There is no evidence of a full-account or bulk export, of open export formats, or of an offboarding or 'leave' workflow; the general APIs and Python client are only building blocks. Missing for 10: comprehensive all-data export (messages, contacts, call logs, transcripts, AI data), documented open file formats, self-serve bulk or account export tooling, independent corroboration.
